comment: Texte de la carte, consommé dans l'ordre par --next. Une ligne = une vidéo. Ajoute-en à la fin quand le stock baisse.

caption.comment: Legende du reel : la ligne de la carte, puis les deux lignes du compte, puis les 2 hashtags fixes + 3 tires a tour de role dans le pool (5 au total).

texts: how it feels to check the mail on a saturday
me explaining the plot to someone who never asked
opening the fridge again hoping something changed
walking into a room and forgetting why instantly
the five minutes before an alarm you did not need
pretending to look for it after getting caught
reading the same line four times and giving up
saying you will start tomorrow for the ninth time
watching the loading bar like it needs support
laughing at a message you will never reply to
standing up and deciding that was enough for today
checking the time and immediately forgetting it
putting the thing down and never seeing it again
agreeing with something you did not hear at all
waiting for the microwave with zero other plans
closing the tab and opening the same one again
explaining a joke until nobody finds it funny
acting normal after tripping on absolutely nothing
the sound of your own name across a quiet room
leaving the house and testing the door six times
typing a reply and deleting it word by word
hearing your voice on a recording for once
waking up before the alarm and feeling betrayed
holding a screenshot you will never look at again
finding a snack you forgot you were saving
the exact second the wifi decides to leave
rereading your own message after sending it
counting stairs for no reason and losing track
putting on headphones with nothing playing
deciding the dishes are a problem for later
smiling at someone who was waving behind you
opening an app and forgetting what you wanted
the pause after saying something slightly wrong
carrying everything in one trip out of principle
watching a tutorial instead of doing the thing
sitting in the car for a while before going in
hearing a noise and deciding it was nothing
the moment a song ends and silence hits harder
pressing a button that was already pressed
arriving early and pretending you meant to
